title: Stones on Mount Shelem
summary: The brother of Jared carries sixteen molten stones to the top of Mount Shelem.

explicit_facts.text: The brother of Jared prepared sixteen small stones from rock; they were white and clear, like transparent glass.
He carried the stones in his hands to the top of Mount Shelem, which was called so because of its exceeding height.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The sixteen stones can be shown in his hands.
unspecified_visual_details: His clothing and appearance; the exact shape and size of the stones; the mountain's terrain and surroundings.

title: A Prayer for Light
summary: At the mount, the brother of Jared prays to the Lord about the journey across the deep and asks that the stones be touched so they will shine in darkness.

explicit_facts.text: He asks the Lord to touch the stones and prepare them to shine in darkness in the vessels for light while crossing the sea.
He says the people have been in the wilderness for many years and asks the Lord to turn away anger and not let them cross the raging deep in darkness.
He acknowledges the Lord's power and asks that the Lord not be angry with him for his weakness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared can be shown praying while holding or presenting the stones.
unspecified_visual_details: The Lord's appearance; the appearance of the vessels, sea, wilderness, and darkness.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer is an address to the Lord; the Lord is not described as visibly present in these verses.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the sea crossing or the vessels as present events.

title: The Lord Touches the Stones
summary: The Lord stretches forth his hand and touches the stones one by one; the brother of Jared sees the Lord's finger and falls in fear.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord stretches forth his hand and touches the stones one by one with his finger.
The veil is taken from the brother of Jared's eyes, and he sees the Lord's finger, which is like a man's finger, flesh and blood.
The brother of Jared falls down before the Lord because he is struck with fear.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Show the Lord's hand and finger touching the stones, without depicting more of the Lord's body than stated.
unspecified_visual_details: The visual form of the veil's removal; whether the stones visibly begin to shine.

prohibited_inventions: Do not add a visible full appearance of the Lord at this moment.

title: Arise
summary: The Lord asks the fallen brother of Jared why he has fallen. The brother of Jared answers that he saw the Lord's finger and feared being smitten.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord sees the brother of Jared fallen to earth and asks why he has fallen.
The brother of Jared says he saw the Lord's finger and feared the Lord would smite him, not knowing that the Lord had flesh and blood.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared may be shown on the ground as the Lord speaks.
unspecified_visual_details: The Lord's appearance beyond the finger already described.

title: A Question of Faith
summary: The Lord explains that the brother of Jared saw the finger because of his faith, asks whether he saw more, and asks whether he believes the words to come. The brother of Jared asks the Lord to show himself and affirms that the Lord speaks truth.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord says the brother of Jared saw the finger because of his faith and asks whether he saw more.
The brother of Jared asks the Lord to show himself.
The Lord asks whether he believes the words the Lord will speak; the brother of Jared answers that he does and that the Lord speaks truth and cannot lie.

title: The Lord Shows Himself
summary: The Lord shows himself to the brother of Jared, declares that he is Jesus Christ, and speaks of redeeming his people and giving life to those who believe.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord shows himself to the brother of Jared and says the people are redeemed from the fall and brought back into his presence.
He identifies himself as Jesus Christ and says he was prepared from the foundation of the world to redeem his people.
He says that in him all mankind shall have life eternally, and believers shall become his sons and daughters.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Show Jesus Christ as appearing to the brother of Jared; no additional appearance details are specified here.
unspecified_visual_details: Jesus Christ's clothing, features, posture, and the appearance of the surrounding space.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: Moroni later says Jesus showed himself in the spirit, in the manner and likeness of the same body as when he showed himself to the Nephites (Ether 3:17).
prohibited_inventions: Do not add details of Jesus Christ's appearance beyond what the account states.

title: Created in His Image
summary: Jesus Christ teaches that people were created in his image and that the body the brother of Jared sees is the body of his spirit.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says no man had previously believed in him as the brother of Jared did and that all men were created in his image.
Jesus says the body seen by the brother of Jared is the body of his spirit, and that he will appear to his people in the flesh as he appears to the brother of Jared in the spirit.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Show Jesus Christ speaking to the brother of Jared in the appearance established in the preceding scene.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This teaching describes the spirit body and future appearance; it does not narrate a separate future event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a future appearance in the flesh as a present scene.

title: Moroni's Account
summary: Moroni explains that Jesus showed himself in the spirit and ministered to the brother of Jared, so that he would know that Jesus was God.

explicit_facts.text: Moroni says Jesus showed himself to the brother of Jared in the spirit, after the manner and likeness of the same body as when he showed himself to the Nephites.
Moroni says Jesus ministered to the brother of Jared, that he might know Jesus was God because of the great works shown to him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The account refers back to the encounter already shown; it does not specify a new visual moment.
unspecified_visual_details: The specific acts of ministering and the great works referred to.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These are Moroni's retrospective comments, not a newly described event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent additional visions or depict unspecified great works.

title: The Veil Opened
summary: Moroni says the brother of Jared beheld within the veil, saw the finger of Jesus, and then saw Jesus and was ministered to by him.

explicit_facts.text: The brother of Jared saw the finger of Jesus and fell with fear; he had faith no longer, for he knew without doubting.
Having perfect knowledge of God, he could not be kept from within the veil; he saw Jesus, who ministered to him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: This passage recounts the same encounter and may be represented as a recap rather than an additional event.
unspecified_visual_details: The visual appearance of the veil and the acts of ministry.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: Moroni recounts the vision retrospectively; do not conflate this recap with a new encounter.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent an additional falling or separate appearance.

title: Keep What Was Seen and Heard Secret
summary: The Lord tells the brother of Jared to keep what he has seen and heard from the world. He instructs him to write and seal it later, promises him two stones to seal with the writing, and says the stones will magnify the writing in his due time.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord tells the brother of Jared not to let what he has seen and heard go forth unto the world until the Lord glorifies his name in the flesh.
The Lord instructs him to treasure up what he has seen and heard and show it to no man.
The Lord says he will write and seal these things in a language that cannot be read.
The Lord says he will give him two stones to seal with the writing.
The Lord says he has confounded the language and will, in his due time, cause the stones to magnify the writing to the eyes of men.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The brother of Jared may be shown listening while the Lord speaks.
unspecified_visual_details: The physical setting and the brother of Jared's appearance are not specified in these verses.
These verses do not describe a visible appearance of the Lord or the stones.
